entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this ridiculous jersey I bought. It's the completely wrong size and I'm not paying for something I can't even wear. This is unbelievable.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your order, sir. I can definitely look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
I just told you! Are you not listening? The jersey is the wrong size! It's way too tight, I can barely get it on. I need to exchange it, and I need to do it now. This whole process is a joke.

I understand your frustration, and I apologize for the inconvenience. Let me just pull up your account to find the best way to resolve this. Can I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?
It's michael.peters@email.com. Just hurry up. I don't have all day. If you can't fix this, put your manager on the phone. I'm one step away from blasting your company all over social media.

Thank you, Michael. I'm pulling up your order now... one moment. Okay, I see your order for the Pro-Vent jersey, delivered about 20 days ago. I've reviewed our policy, and because this is a standard apparel item, you're well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you.
Wait, really? So you can just process the exchange? I thought it was going to be a whole thing.
Not at all. I can process an exchange for the correct size right now, or I can issue a full refund if you prefer. Since you mentioned the jersey is too tight, I'm happy to help you get the right fit.
Oh. Okay then. Yeah, an exchange is what I want. I need a large instead of a medium.

Excellent. I've just processed the exchange for a size large. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email now. Just pack up the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. As soon as we see the return has been scanned, we'll ship out your new one.
Alright, that works. I see the email just came through. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Michael?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
